title: 第20章 今晚必须拿下李大壮~~~
novel_title: 神医小傻驴的乡村女人
content_zh:
原本只能算是正常成色的葡萄，竟然迅速长大起来，颜色也变成了更诱人的紫，而且每一颗都散发着诱人的葡萄香味，那味道，比普通葡萄更浓烈，却又不会过于甜腻，反倒勾的人口水直流！

    眼看着每一粒葡萄都长成小鸡蛋那么大了，李大壮连忙停了手！

    “啥味？咋这么香甜？”张桂芬吸着鼻子回头一看，差点没从椅子上摔下来！

    “哎呦我滴个娘哎！咱家葡萄成精了！？”

    张桂芬看着那一颗颗圆润饱满，挂着露水，在清晨的阳光下散发着莹润水光，和勾人香气的大紫葡萄，简直惊呆了，当场摘了一颗，可一张嘴都塞不下，只能先咬了一口！

    葡萄极致的清新香甜，瞬间充斥了张桂芬的口腔，满满的汁液像是鲜榨葡萄汁一般丰盛，只一口，仿佛把她的灵魂都要吃出窍了~

    “大早晨叫唤啥？不就是个葡……”

    刚从屋里出来的李守义话还没说完就愣住了：“咱家葡萄咋这么多，这么大了！？”

    “爸，你尝尝，保证让你比老妈还激动！”

    李守义从闻见葡萄味就想吃了，这会儿更是忍不住连忙摘了一颗咬了一大口！

    “哎呦！这是葡萄还是仙果啊！我这辈子就没吃过这么好吃的东西！”

    李守义果然激动了！

    正好李秋霜也端着面条出来了，李大壮连忙摘了一颗葡萄喂给她吃，李秋霜惊讶的张开小嘴，只咬了一口，就享受的眯起了眼睛，她的嘴比张桂芬的还小，那满溢的葡萄汁几乎装不下，从小巧的唇角缓缓流出……

    “天呐！太美味了~~”

    “大壮，是你把咱家葡萄变成这样的对不对？肯定是你，你的本事这么大，这事儿除了你，没人能做到！”

    李秋霜一脸崇拜的看着李大壮，漂亮的眸子里仿佛盛满了小星星，闪着亮晶晶的光。

    “真的假的？”

    “大壮还有这本事！？”

    李守义和张桂芬都有些不敢置信。
content_en:
Li Dazhuang rushed up and discovered that the second floor was an attic with only one room, and the sound came from inside!

    I don't know if the person who did the bad thing was too arrogant and the door was not closed tightly. Li Dazhuang saw the scene in the room through the half-open door at a glance!

    A disheveled snow-white woman was pressed on a small bed by a lustful middle-aged man. The man was touching her obscenely. The woman struggled hard, but she was no match. Next to her stood an eager young man, drooling at the woman!

    The woman is very beautiful and has a very voluptuous figure!

    The torn clothes barely covered a little bit of the snow-white, perfect shape and huge size!

    The arms pinned down by the pervert and the beautiful legs struggling hard are white and long. Even Li Dazhuang, who is surrounded by beautiful women, is a bit stunning at this moment!

    But now was not the time to admire beautiful women. He kicked open the door in front of him and shouted: "Let that woman go!"

    Li Dazhuang's sudden appearance shocked the two men, especially the middle-aged man who was about to raise his gun and mount his horse. He collapsed on the spot and fell off the woman's body!

    The already desperate beauty seemed to have seen a savior. Her tearful eyes looked eagerly at Li Dazhuang: "Handsome man, please save me!"

    Another young man also turned around sharply, but only saw Li Dazhuang. He suddenly became arrogant: "Fuck! How dare you dare to imitate other people's heroes and save the beautiful! I can knock you down alone!"

    "You can try!" Li Dazhuang looked at the young man with a cold face, as if he were an ant!

    "Damn it! Wu Erpi, what are you waiting for? Go and kill him quickly! Damn it! I'm so scared by him that I can't even stand up!"

    "Okay, big brother!" the young man agreed, and immediately rushed towards Li Dazhuang with his fist raised!

    Li Dazhuang sneered, flew up and kicked him!

    "Ah!" Wu Erpi felt a sharp pain in his chest. His whole body flew up and hit the wall again. Then he landed heavily and vomited a mouthful of blood on the spot!

    The middle-aged man Wu Dapi was dumbfounded: "Erpi! What's wrong with you!?"

    "Brother! It hurts!!" Wu Erpi's mouth was full of blood and he couldn't speak clearly.

    "Fuck! I'll fight you!" Wu Dapi actually took out a fruit knife from behind and stabbed Li Dazhuang!

    The beauty on the bed suddenly felt excited, and the half-covered snow-white body in front of her was also trembling!

    Li Dazhuang didn't panic at all. He turned slightly sideways, dodged the fruit knife, grabbed it with his backhand, and broke Wu Dapi's knife-hand in half!

    "Ahh!!" Wu Dapi's scream instantly overwhelmed Wu Erpi!
title_en: Chapter 21 The sexy beauty boss acts coquettishly and asks for help
